--- pipe_aggregate_trailing_comma_before_group_by.sql
FROM Sales
|> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n, GROUP BY region

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 10,
            Name:    "Sales",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAggregate{
        Pipe:  11,
        Items: []*ast.PipeAggregateItem{
          &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            DirPos: -1,
            Expr:   &ast.CountStarExpr{
              Count:  24,
              Rparen: 31,
            },
            As: &ast.AsAlias{
              As:    33,
              Alias: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 36,
                NameEnd: 37,
                Name:    "n",
              },
            },
          },
        },
        GroupBy: &ast.PipeAggregateGroupBy{
          Group:  39,
          And:    -1,
          Order:  -1,
          By:     45,
          Lparen: -1,
          Rparen: -1,
          Items:  []*ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
            &ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
              DirPos: -1,
              Expr:   &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 48,
                NameEnd: 54,
                Name:    "region",
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Sales |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY region
